description: Shared Renovate policy for MRegra's repos: extend it with "github>MRegra/fedora-workstation-scripts//renovate/default". One edit here reaches every repo that extends it.
It lives in a public repo on purpose: a repo-scoped fine-grained RENOVATE_TOKEN can read public repos, so every repo can resolve it whoever owns the token.
Weekly grouped non-major PRs per ecosystem, majors one PR each, security fixes immediately, safe Renovate-side automerge only after every check is green.
Digest/pin updates carry no upstream release date, so the release-age wait would hold them forever; the age guard applies to version updates only.
Non-major updates: one PR per ecosystem per week.
Majors stay one PR per dependency so each is reviewed on its own; never automerged.
Automerge patch, digest and pin updates (and lockFileMaintenance below) only when Renovate itself sees every status check on the branch green.

platformAutomerge is off on purpose: these repos have no branch protection or required checks, so GitHub native auto-merge would merge without waiting for CI. Renovate-side automerge (automergeType pr, ignoreTests false) merges on a later run only after all checks pass, and a branch with no checks at all is never automerged.
A grouped branch automerges only if every update in it is eligible, so a group that contains a minor bump waits for a human.
0.x releases make no compatibility promise: no automerge for them.
